The '''Khoan system''' was located in the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Khoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as the creatures known as [[Khoanian slime crab]]s.<ref name="SL" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Khoan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
